newsitem.title: USA: White House says Clinton will sign spending bill.
newsitem.headline: White House says Clinton will sign spending bill.

text.p: The White House said President Clinton was expected to sign a federal government spending bill for fiscal 1997 by the midnight Monday deadline. The government's new fiscal year begins on Tuesday.

"It was passed by the House, and we expect it will be passed by the Senate later today," White House chief of staff Leon Panetta told reporters at the White House. "When that happens, the president will sign it into law ...that should happen tonight." White House press secretary Mike McCurry said Clinotn would sign by midnight EDT/0400 GMT.
